Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce marry in New York ceremony

Pop superstar Taylor Swift and NFL player Travis Kelce have married in a ceremony at New York's Madison Square Garden. The event, attended by numerous celebrities, was reportedly officiated by actor Adam Sandler. The wedding generated significant global attention, with reports of guests signing non-disclosure agreements.
